name: Unnan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Unnan city emblem in red and orange: a red disc with a white cloud-like top bearing an orange sun.
history: Municipal flag of Unnan, a city in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Unnan city emblem — a red disc with a white cloud-like top bearing an orange sun
